feed_summary: Managing access to security tools shouldn't require another manual process. As organizations grow, keeping user accounts and permissions up to date becomes increasingly complex. Employees join, change roles, and leave, creating a constant need to update access across applications. When these processes rely on manual administration, delays and oversights can introduce unnecessary work and security risk. Rapid7 Command Platform now supports System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), enabling customers to automate user provisioning and deprovisioning through their existing identity provider (IdP). This helps organizations reduce administrative overhead, maintain more consistent access controls, and manage identity at scale. Automate user access throughout the employee lifecycle SCIM
title: Simplify User Access Management with SCIM on Rapid7 Command Platform
